description: Get EJScreen environmental-justice indicators for a point and surrounding buffer. Returns the 13 EJScreen environmental indicators (PM2.5, ozone, diesel particulate, NO2, lead paint, traffic proximity, Superfund/RMP/hazardous-waste/wastewater proximity, underground storage tanks, drinking-water non-compliance, and RSEI toxic air releases) and 6 demographic indicators (people of color, low income, limited English, less than high school, under 5, over 64), each with national and state percentiles plus EJ Index values, along with the Demographic Index and Supplemental Demographic Index. Data is EJScreen v2.2 (2022) served via the community-maintained EJAM API (api.ejanalysis.com, Public Environmental Data Partners), which rehosts EJScreen after EPA discontinued public access in 2025 — not a live EPA endpoint. Provide latitude, longitude, and a buffer distance (default 1 mile, max 15 miles). Points outside US coverage return a coverage note instead of indicators.

distance.description: Buffer radius around the point, in the given unit (default 1). The miles-equivalent must be 15 or less.

unit.description: Unit for distance. Kilometers are converted to miles (× 0.621371) before the request.

name: epa_get_ejscreen

coverage.description: Whether EJScreen data was available for the point.

note.description: Explanation from EJScreen when coverage is unavailable (e.g. point outside the US).

valid.description: True when EJScreen returned indicators for the point; false when the point is outside coverage.

dataSource.description: Provenance and vintage of the data.

demographic.description: EJScreen demographic indicators present for the area. Empty when out of coverage.

percent.description: Share of the buffer population, as a percentage (0–100).

demographicIndex.description: EJScreen Demographic Index. Absent when out of coverage.

statePercentile.description: State percentile (0–100) of the Demographic Index.

usPercentile.description: National percentile (0–100) of the Demographic Index.

value.description: Demographic Index raw value (average of low-income and people-of-color shares).

environmental.description: EJScreen environmental indicators present for the area. Empty when out of coverage.

items.description: One environmental indicator with percentiles and its EJ Index.

ejIndex.description: EJ Index (raw) — the indicator combined with the demographic index.

ejIndexStatePercentile.description: State percentile (0–100) of the EJ Index.

ejIndexUsPercentile.description: National percentile (0–100) of the EJ Index.

statePercentile.description: State percentile (0–100) for the raw value.

unit.description: Unit or scale of the raw value.

usPercentile.description: National percentile (0–100) for the raw value.

value.description: Raw indicator value, in the unit given by the unit field.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `buffer_too_large`: The buffer radius exceeds the EJAM API cap of 15 miles (after converting kilometers to miles). `upstream_rejected`: The EJAM API rejected the request, typically for invalid coordinates. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

location.description: The queried location and buffer context.

blockGroupCount.description: Number of census block groups intersecting the buffer. Absent when out of coverage.

bufferMiles.description: Buffer radius in miles used for the query (kilometers inputs converted first).

latitude.description: Latitude of the queried point in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the queried point in decimal degrees.

population.description: Area-weighted population within the buffer. Absent when out of coverage.

state.description: 2-letter state abbreviation for the area (e.g. "MD"). Absent when out of coverage.

stateName.description: Full state name (e.g. "Maryland"). Absent when out of coverage.

notice.description: Guidance when the point is outside EJScreen coverage and no indicators were returned.

reportUrl.description: Link (absolute URL) to the full EJScreen report for this point and buffer.

supplementalDemographicIndex.description: EJScreen Supplemental Demographic Index. Absent when out of coverage.

statePercentile.description: State percentile (0–100) of the Supplemental Demographic Index.

usPercentile.description: National percentile (0–100) of the Supplemental Demographic Index.

value.description: Supplemental Demographic Index raw value (five-factor average).

title: Get EJScreen Environmental Justice Indicators
